title: [IMP2-15] A message request accepted after relay retention cannot catch up
description: Review finding IMP2-15: A message request accepted after relay retention cannot catch up (lens IMP2). Location: spec/04-access-control.md:211; spec/05-messaging.md:28, :420. Fix: Real, but the fix follows from existing text. 04:211 makes "MUST NOT authenticate ... or fetch" an explicit privacy rule with only the regulated-member exception (04:213, 07:285), so option (a) would reverse it. 05:28 already uses "must be removed and re-added" for a member that cannot follow. Generalize: a client that finds it cannot reach the group's current epoch because Commits have left relay retention (after a request, or after any long offline period) deletes the group state and tells the user that a member must re-add them. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
